template.script: /* === FLÈCHES CAROUSEL === */ document.querySelectorAll('.exo-carousel-btn').forEach(function(btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', function() { var targetId = btn.getAttribute('data-target'); var carousel = document.getElementById(targetId); if (!carousel) return; var scrollAmount = 320; if (btn.classList.contains('exo-carousel-prev')) { carousel.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' }); } else { carousel.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' }); } }); }); window.addEventListener('load', function () { /* === NIVEAU 1 — déplie/replie les sous-catégories === */ document.querySelectorAll('.exo-l1-header').forEach(function(h) { var body = h.nextElementSibling; var chev = h.querySelector('.exo-l1-chevron'); body.style.display = 'none'; h.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target.tagName === 'A') return; e.preventDefault(); var isOpen = body.style.display !== 'none'; /* Ferme tous les L1 du même groupe */ var parent = h.closest('.exo-cat1-group'); if (parent) { parent.querySelectorAll('.exo-l1-header').forEach(function(sib) { if (sib === h) return; var sibBody = sib.nextElementSibling; var sibChev = sib.querySelector('.exo-l1-chevron'); if (sibBody) sibBody.style.display = 'none'; if (sibChev) { sibChev.style.transform = ''; sibChev.style.color = ''; } if (sibBody) { sibBody.querySelectorAll('.exo-l2-header').forEach(function(l2h) { var l2b = l2h.nextElementSibling; var l2c = l2h.querySelector('.exo-l2-chevron'); if (l2b) l2b.style.display = 'none'; if (l2c) { l2c.style.transform = ''; l2c.style.color = ''; } }); } }); } if (isOpen) { body.style.display = 'none'; chev.style.transform = ''; chev.style.color = ''; body.querySelectorAll('.exo-l2-header').forEach(function(l2h) { var l2b = l2h.nextElementSibling; var l2c = l2h.querySelector('.exo-l2-chevron'); if (l2b) l2b.style.display = 'none'; if (l2c) { l2c.style.transform = ''; l2c.style.color = ''; } }); } else { body.style.display = 'flex'; body.style.flexDirection = 'column'; chev.style.transform = 'rotate(90deg)'; chev.style.color = '#0d4dff'; } }); }); /* === NIVEAU 2 — déplie/replie les marques === */ document.querySelectorAll('.exo-l2-header').forEach(function(h) { var body = h.nextElementSibling; var chev = h.querySelector('.exo-l2-chevron'); body.style.display = 'none'; h.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target.tagName === 'A') return; e.preventDefault(); var isOpen = body.style.display !== 'none'; /* Ferme tous les L2 du même L1 */ var parentL1 = h.closest('.exo-l1-body'); if (parentL1) { parentL1.querySelectorAll('.exo-l2-header').forEach(function(sib) { if (sib === h) return; var sibBody = sib.nextElementSibling; var sibChev = sib.querySelector('.exo-l2-chevron'); if (sibBody) sibBody.style.display = 'none'; if (sibChev) { sibChev.style.transform = ''; sibChev.style.color = ''; } }); } if (isOpen) { body.style.display = 'none'; chev.style.transform = ''; chev.style.color = ''; } else { body.style.display = 'flex'; body.style.flexDirection = 'column'; chev.style.transform = 'rotate(90deg)'; chev.style.color = '#0d4dff'; } }); }); /* === LIENS sidebar — chargent dans l'iframe === */ document.querySelectorAll('.exo-l1-header a, .exo-l2-header a, .exo-leaf').forEach(function(a) { a.addEventListener('click', function(e) { var href = a.getAttribute('href'); if (!href || href === '#') return; /* Le target="exo-shop-frame" s'occupe du chargement dans l'iframe */ }); }); }); /* === CAROUSEL FLÈCHES + AUTOPLAY === */ function exoCarouselScroll(id, dir) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el) return; var card = el.querySelector('.exo-product-card'); var w = card ? card.offsetWidth + 12 : 300; el.scrollBy({ left: dir * w * 3, behavior: 'smooth' }); } document.querySelectorAll('.exo-carousel-btn').forEach(function(btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', function() { var id = btn.getAttribute('data-target'); var dir = btn.classList.contains('exo-carousel-prev') ? -1 : 1; exoCarouselScroll(id, dir); }); }); /* Autoplay toutes les 4 secondes */ ['carousel-new', 'carousel-best'].forEach(function(id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el) return; setInterval(function() { var maxScroll = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth; if (el.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 10) { el.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); } else { var card = el.querySelector('.exo-product-card'); var w = card ? card.offsetWidth + 12 : 300; el.scrollBy({ left: w, behavior: 'smooth' }); } }, 4000); });
